subject.title: feat(ui): Home page and identity-row IA for the five-zone sidebar

question: Should the owner approve the Home-first/identity-menu sidebar IA after the native-control and route-selection regressions are corrected and demonstrated in a real setup?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes primary navigation semantics and carries a `maintainer` label; code review can identify regressions but cannot substitute for the product owner's acceptance of the resulting IA.

options.title: Approve the direction after corrections
options.body: Keep the Home-first IA, fix both regressions, and review redacted real web/native proof before merging.

options.title: Preserve the prior sidebar semantics
options.body: Retain the existing five-zone sidebar behavior and close this follow-up if the owner no longer wants the Home/Pages restructuring.

recommendation.title: Approve the direction after corrections
recommendation.body: Keep the Home-first IA, fix both regressions, and review redacted real web/native proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored and landed the current five-zone sidebar baseline and proposed this owner-directed follow-up.
